name: mcp-upgrade-monorepo
description: Monorepo for the mcp-upgrade CLI and the hosted MCP upgrade validator.
author: Jacob Ryan (https://github.com/JacobRyan258)

scripts.build:all: npm run build --workspace @mcp-upgrade/shared && npm run build --workspace mcp-upgrade && npm run build --workspace @mcp-upgrade/database && npm run build --workspace @mcp-upgrade/worker && npm run build --workspace @mcp-upgrade/web
scripts.build:libs: npm run build --workspace @mcp-upgrade/shared && npm run build --workspace mcp-upgrade && npm run build --workspace @mcp-upgrade/database
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @mcp-upgrade/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace mcp-upgrade && npm run typecheck --workspace @mcp-upgrade/database && npm run typecheck --workspace @mcp-upgrade/worker && npm run typecheck --workspace @mcp-upgrade/web && npm run typecheck:scripts
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace mcp-upgrade && npm run lint --workspace @mcp-upgrade/shared && npm run lint --workspace @mcp-upgrade/database && npm run lint --workspace @mcp-upgrade/worker && npm run lint --workspace @mcp-upgrade/web && npm run lint:scripts
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace mcp-upgrade && npm run test --workspace @mcp-upgrade/shared && npm run test --workspace @mcp-upgrade/database && npm run test --workspace @mcp-upgrade/worker && npm run test --workspace @mcp-upgrade/web && npm run test:scripts
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run check:secrets && npm run verify:env-files && npm run build
